question: What does h2 ~ p { } select?
answers: Every p following an h2 that shares the same parent
Only the first p immediately after an h2
All p elements anywhere on the page
explanation: ~ is the subsequent-sibling combinator. Matches following p siblings with the same parent; they need not be adjacent.

question: What does .task-list > .task-card { } select?
answers: All descendants with the class task-card
Only direct child elements with the class task-card
Only the very first task card

question: What does h2 + p { } select?
answers: The first paragraph child of h2
A p immediately following h2 as a sibling
explanation: + is the next-sibling combinator. Both elements must share a parent and p must immediately follow h2.

question: What does .task-list .task-card { } select?
answers: Task cards that are descendants of .task-list, at any depth
Only task cards with the same parent as .task-list
explanation: A space between selectors represents the descendant combinator.

question: Which selector matches every p sibling after an h2, not just the adjacent one?
explanation: h2 ~ p matches later paragraph siblings. The direction of the selectors matters.
